Troubleshoot a rear power outlet that fails to supply power to your exhaust fan or air pump. Learn how to check the TL-Timer board settings.

Problem Description

When an exhaust fan or air pump is connected to the corresponding power outlet on the rear of the machine, it does not turn on.

Using a multimeter to measure the voltage at the outlet shows a reading of 0V, indicating that the outlet is not supplying power.

Solution

Step 1. Set the Mode Switch on the TL-Timer Board to the Right

Open the lower panel on the right side of the machine. Locate the TL-Timer board inside the machine. Then find the mode switch on the board and move it to the right to select Manual mode.

Step 2. Check the Indicator Lights and Outlet Power

 

Check whether the indicator light for the corresponding output terminal is illuminated. Then, use a multimeter to measure the voltage at the corresponding outlet and verify that power is being supplied.

In most cases, the outlets should resume normal operation after completing these steps.

 

Important Reminder:

If these steps do not resolve the issue, please submit a support ticket on ZOHO: https://zohodesk.1laser.com/portal/en/newticket. A technician will then be able to conduct a more in-depth diagnosis and resolve your problem.
